title: IFRA shares update at FFAS Annual General Meeting in Singapore
summary: IFRA was invited once again to share an update with the Fragrance and Flavor Association of Singapore community at its Annual General Meeting.

companies: Fragrance and Flavor Association of Singapore
extraction.key_fact: IFRA가 싱가포르 향료 협회 연례 총회에서 최신 현황을 공유했다.
